description: This file defines navigation utilities and route management functions for the Notesnook mobile app, including route updates, navigation actions, and references to various store modules.

methods.name: clearRouteFromQueue
methods.description: Removes a route from the update queue if present.

methods.name: routeNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Checks if a route needs an update and executes a callback if so.

methods.name: queueRoutesForUpdate
methods.description: Adds routes to the update queue and triggers update functions for the current route.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates to a specified route with optional parameters.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates back to the previous route.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new route onto the navigation stack.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces the current route with a new one.

methods.name: popToTop
methods.description: Pops the navigation stack to the top route.

methods.name: resetRootState
methods.description: Resets the root navigation state, excluding 'Auth' and 'Welcome' routes unless focused.
